verdict.rationale: Docs and SDK evidence show a consistent Workers runtime, bindings, and storage primitives (KV, D1, Queues, Durable Objects) usable from local dev to global scale without server management, and community posts praise fast prototyping-to-production experience. However, other community feedback notes real scaling limits (CPU-time caps making long-running agent workloads hard, need for workarounds) and lock-in concerns around KV/D1 that force rearchitecting when moving off or beyond Workers, undercutting the 'no rearchitecting' promise.
